news.headline: Draft Right Offer Document of LSEFSL Circular u/s 83 of Companies Act, 2017
news.summary: PSX posted LSE Financial Services' draft right-offer document under section 83 of the Companies Act, 2017. Logged as impact 3, a notable financing development.

news.headline: FNEL unusual movement in price
news.summary: PSX posted First National Equities' unusual-price-movement notice; the filing does not establish a cause in the announcement title. Logged as impact 2, a minor company item.

news.headline: Names of Directors Elected at the Election of Directors held at EGM 2026
news.summary: PSX posted Pakistan Petroleum's notice naming directors elected at its 2026 extraordinary general meeting. Logged as impact 3, notable governance news.

news.headline: PSX: Selling returns as KSE-100 loses nearly 1,400 points
news.summary: Business Recorder reported the KSE-100 settled at 168,021.80 on September 16, down 1,370.52 points or 0.81%, as elevated oil prices and regional tensions weighed on sentiment.

news.headline: Pakistan secures Sept fuel, eyes US crude via VLCC as conflict threatens fuel supplies
news.summary: Pakistan's petroleum minister said September fuel supplies are secured and October is covered under adverse scenarios, while the government is evaluating alternate crude routes and VLCC ship-to-ship transfers amid regional disruption.

news.headline: Oil slips on US stock build, Middle East disruptions limit losses
news.summary: Business Recorder reported Brent crude futures fell 0.67% to $108.02 a barrel, while supply disruptions remained; both benchmarks had settled more than $3 higher on Tuesday.

news.headline: WTL placed in non-compliant segment again after court dismisses relief plea
news.summary: Mettis Global reported WTL was placed back in PSX's Non-Compliant Segment and excluded from NCCPL SLB-B and margin-financing eligibility, with a December 14, 2026 compliance deadline.

news.headline: PSX stages strong rebound
news.summary: Business Recorder reported the KSE-100 closed at 169,043.20 on September 17, up 1,021.40 points or 0.61%, as easing oil prices and possible US-Iran de-escalation improved sentiment.

news.headline: National Bank appeal on pension increases dismissed by Federal Constitutional Court
news.summary: Dawn reported that the Federal Constitutional Court dismissed National Bank's appeal concerning pensioners' entitlement to government-announced pension increases.

news.headline: HSD price rises Rs3.47/litre, petrol falls Rs0.43
news.summary: Mettis Global listed a new domestic fuel-price change: HSD rose Rs3.47 per litre while petrol fell Rs0.43 per litre.

news.headline: SCRA balance drops Rs374m, securities see Rs3bn net selling
news.summary: Mettis Global listed a Rs374 million decline in the SCRA balance alongside Rs3 billion of net selling in securities.

news.headline: SBP Governor credits remittances for reserve build-up, lowest current account deficit
news.summary: Mettis Global listed an SBP Governor statement crediting remittances with reserve build-up and a low current-account deficit.

news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 ends volatile trading session on a positive note
news.summary: Business Recorder reported the KSE-100 settled at 171,153.16 on September 21, up 268.58 points or 0.16%, after a volatile session.

news.headline: Oil prices slide on hopes of diplomacy in Iran war
news.summary: Dawn reported Brent and WTI crude touched their lowest levels since September 10 as diplomatic hopes reduced immediate supply fears.

news.headline: Stocks end volatile week marginally higher on value-hunting
news.summary: Dawn reported the KSE-100 gained 372 points or 0.22% in the week ended September 18, while oil, geopolitics, reserves, trade and current-account data remained key market drivers.
